entries.subject: CHARA/MIRC reconstructed surface image
entries.finding: Zhao et al. 2009 reconstructs an image of the gravity-darkened surface, published as a figure; no image file or calibrated OIFITS release was found in the OiDB at level 3 on 2026-09-21. The package draws the paper's Roche-von Zeipel fit instead.
entries.revisitWhen: A calibrated OIFITS release of the CHARA/MIRC data, which the repository could image with SQUEEZE.
